verdict.rationale: Salesmate is a CRM SaaS with public REST APIs, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials is a fair axis for it. The evidence only says public REST APIs exist; nothing covers credential types, permission scopes, or limiting a token's privileges. The API-docs probes returned 404s and add no detail on credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
